name: VegvisAI open index: political parties in Norway
policy: Every party in Partiregisteret can be listed on the same terms: links to its own public pages, in alphabetical order, never ranked, free of charge. A listing is not an endorsement, and a party that is missing is not less relevant. Any party can take over its own entry at any time, by publishing its own AI catalog file or by asking us, and can ask to be changed or removed.
notice: Unofficial listings made from the parties' own public pages, like the public services in the index (P34). Not made or approved by the parties. The list is not complete yet: every party is welcome.
